messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 321 omitted, sha256 efac3c49d398dc84>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party shall destroy or return some Confidential Information upon the termination of Agreement.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: NotMentioned
confidence: 60
reason: The NDA requires return or destruction of Confidential Information only at the Disclosing Party's request, and it has no termination clause, so the hypothesis's trigger of termination is not addressed.
(no quotes)
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: NotMentioned
confidence: 72
reason: The agreement requires return or destruction of Confidential Information only 'At the request of Disclosing Party', not upon termination of the Agreement, and it contains no termination provision, so the hypothesis is not addressed.
(no quotes)
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 72
reason: The agreement obligates the Recipient to return or destroy Confidential Information upon the Disclosing Party's request, which in this task's convention counts as supporting a return/destroy obligation.
<quote check="exact">At the request of Disclosing Party, Recipient shall return to Disclosing Party all Confidential Information of Disclosing Party (including any copies thereof) or certify the destruction thereof.</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label": "Entailment", "confidence": 62, "quotes": ["At the request of Disclosing Party, Recipient shall return to Disclosing Party all Confidential Information of Disclosing Party (including any copies thereof) or certify the destruction thereof."], "reason": "The Recipient must return or certify destruction of Confidential Information at the Disclosing Party's request, which can be made at any time including on termination, so a return/destroy obligation is clearly established."}
